items.briefing:
Security researchers are warning that cyber criminals are exploiting software vulnerabilities faster than vendors can release fixes, meaning unpatched systems face a growing window of risk. A critical flaw in GitLab requires urgent attention as it can be triggered without any user action, making it particularly dangerous for organisations using the platform. Separately, a threat called "TwinLoot" is running attacks entirely through Microsoft's cloud infrastructure, making it harder to detect with traditional security tools.

Australian staff should also be aware that AI tools like Microsoft Copilot can potentially be manipulated to reveal sensitive system information. **Practical tip:** Ensure any software — especially GitLab and Microsoft 365 tools — is updated promptly, and report anything unusual to your IT team straight away.

featured.title: Frontier AI is perishable commodity, says Kinetic IT
featured.summary: Businesses risk lock-in unless they build AI governance and resilience, as frontier models can quickly lose their edge, Kinetic IT says.
